description: The plot illustrates Pass@8 accuracy on merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC data as a function of generation temperature. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@8 Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “LUFFY”, a dashed orange line representing “SFT”, and a solid red line representing “RL”. The LUFFY line starts at approximately 0.08 at a temperature of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.88 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT line begins at approximately 0.28 at a temperature of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.76 at a temperature of 1.0. The RL line starts at approximately 0.18 at a temperature of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.68 at a temperature of 1.0.
